series: Why we stop doing things we know are good for us, Reason #19 (borrowed sleep)
hook: On six hours of sleep, you feel fine. You're not.

gate.goal_link: side goals (an app, a course, a book) get the hours after 11 PM; the sleep debt makes the work slow and the person concludes they are 'not good at this'
gate.mechanism: chronic sleep restriction: performance keeps falling while felt sleepiness levels off, so you cannot feel the drop (Van Dongen et al. 2003, 14 days of 6 h; stated as 'sleep researchers found', not quoted with numbers beyond what the study showed)
gate.universal: staying up late to finally work on your own thing

frame.want: Dev wants to ship his app
frame.obstacle: only free after 11 PM, codes till 1 AM, output falls week by week, decides he is not good at this
frame.cost: same 2 hours a night: 6 features in week 1, 1 in week 3 (story numbers)
frame.fix: fixed lights-out 11:30, the code moves to the time before work
